definition: [ קָצַב ] verb cut off, shear (?) (Late Hebrew קָצַב decide, determine , Pi`el chop meat; Palmyrene קצבא butcher , so Syriac , Jewish-Aramaic קַצָּכָא , and Arabic as loan-word Frä 258 ; Arabic also is cut off a branch); — Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular וַיִקְצָכעֵץֿ 2Kgs 6:6 he cut off a stick; Passive participle feminine plural עֵדֶר הַקְּצוּבוֺת Song 4:2 a flock of (sheep) that are shorn (?).

Qal Imperfect 3 masculine singular וַיִקְצָכעֵץֿ 2Kgs 6:6 he cut off a stick; Passive participle feminine plural עֵדֶר הַקְּצוּבוֺת Song 4:2 a flock of (sheep) that are shorn (?).
